voice.name: The Neighbor
voice.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent

lines.text: Moving tokens across chains usually means trusting a black box.
You sign, you wait, and you hope it lands.
RelayMesh opens the box, right on Portal Dot.
Choose where it goes, and see each fee before you pay. Then sign once.
Watch each step settle live, block by block, until the funds arrive on the other side.
You get a receipt, and its hash is anchored on chain. Anyone can check it, right in their browser.
It also checks the bridge to B N B Chain, payout by payout, and anchors the result.
And developers get all of it through an open API, ready to call.
RelayMesh. Cross-chain transfers you can prove.
